description: The figure is a two-level donut/pie chart summarizing a set of instruction-following task categories and their counts, grouped into three higher-level phases in the inner ring. The outer ring contains 9 slices labeled (with callouts) Triggering (light blue, 100), Recursive Reasoning (bright blue, 110), Dynamic Environment (dark blue, 100), Memorization (very light cyan, 100), Dynamic Instruction (cyan, 100), Multitasking (green-teal, 160), Primary Instruction (red, 111; label partially obscured), Personalization (salmon, 100), and Prioritization (light pink, 100); these values correspond to approximate proportions of about 10% each for the 100-count slices, ~11% for 110, ~11% for 111, and ~16% for 160 out of the total. The inner ring has 3 slices labeled Context Tracking (dark blue), Context Retrieving (dark teal), and Contradiction Resolution (brown), each spanning roughly one-third of the circle, with the inner labels placed inside the segments. There is no separate legend; the outer slices are separated by thick white borders and annotated via leader lines, and no slice appears exploded beyond the standard spacing, with segments arranged around the circle rather than clearly sorted by size.
